objective: Define what must be true before a Verilator-facing native invocation may be treated as direct sidecar stage launch authority, while keeping this gate definition-only and avoiding direct execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, raw full-state equality, or production LLM-serving throughput claims.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The source review accepted parser success plus a scoped reviewed sidecar execution, but those two facts are still separated. This boundary defines the missing direct-launch authority chain; it does not prove that a Verilator process launched sidecar stages.
reason: the first scoped run review accepted patched-parser success and sidecar execution as separated evidence
the next usability gap is connecting a Verilator-facing process invocation to sidecar stage launch authority
the boundary must keep generated command text, wrapper execution, and stage-plan metadata non-authoritative unless a later run explicitly proves the chain
coverage_output_equivalence remains a scoped compare policy and not a raw-state equality claim

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the real Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before the expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.direct_launch_handoff_failure: the native invocation parse succeeds, but explicit sidecar context or launch handoff is not connected to the run record
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_authority_failure: reviewed stage authority is absent or mismatched for the scoped target/template/shape
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: one of the scoped sidecar build/run stages fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_tests_for_next_review: the definition uses the first scoped sidecar execution run review as its source artifact
direct launch authority requires one native invocation record that links process parse, sidecar context, reviewed stage authority, sidecar launch, and compare
parser success, wrapper execution, generated command text, and stage-plan metadata alone are not launch authority
coverage_output_equivalence output words remain explicit and raw full-state equality remains non-required
generated reports and artifacts stay evidence-only
timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, and production throughput remain blocked

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_sidecar_launch_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the direct-launch authority chain is narrow enough after the separated parser-success plus sidecar-execution review
whether one run record must connect process parse, sidecar context, reviewed stage authority, sidecar launch, and compare
whether generated command text, wrapper execution, parser success, and stage-plan metadata remain non-authoritative
whether the pulp_ita_mha 64x1 scope remains explicit
whether coverage_output_equivalence remains the scoped output policy without raw-state equality
whether timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI, and production throughput remain non-claims
must_not_claim: direct Verilator sidecar execution by this definition

non_claims: not broad native Verilator option support
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
